notes.title: Update 6 - 08.04.2025
notes.notes:
This update fixed a few minor issues and one bigger bug:

-Fixed that it was possible to re-visit [spoiler]the large area in Graham Manor 3F after having survived the enemy ambush with Olivia[/spoiler]

notes.title: Update 5 - 03.03.2025
notes.notes:
Update 5 - 03.03.2025
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some Xbox Controllers didn't properly register Select/Back/View- as well as R2-button presses when connected via Bluetooth
[*] Fixed a glitch where Olivia moved weirdly in place for a few frames during one of the last dialogue scenes
[*] Fixed a bug where a boss could get briefly stuck in the walls
[*] Fixed a bug where a sound in an endgame scene was played multiple times at once
[*] Fixed a typo in the English achievement descriptions
[*] Fixed the map layout in Graham Manor 1F for the puzzle room with the two statues and the large chest
[/list]

notes.title: Update 4 - 16.02.2025
notes.notes:
Update 4 - 16.02.2025

Hi all. There is a new update for Dead of Darkness. 
There was one game breaking bug that would cause Olivia to lose all items from her inventory and itemchest during a switch from Olivia to Miles. This was reported to me two times. The bad thing about this bug is that you will only notice it ~1 hour after it happened. 
Should you have run into this issue, please reach out to me either on Discord or contact[ at ]retrofictiongames[ dot ]com, so that we can see if I can help you fix your save game. 
More details below:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could crash in the bar in Graham Manor when accidentally clicking with the mouse on a invisible debugging trigger area in the outer frame of the room
[*] Fixed a bug where skipping the [spoiler]St. Albion sequence AFTER Olivia gave Miles the injection[/spoiler] could cause Olivias data to be erased (inventory, itemchest etc.)
[*] Fixed a bug where blood pools were visible on the floor during the cutscenes in the wellspring in which the spike traps were deactivated, in case the player was suffering from the bleed status
[*] Fixed a bug where painkillers didn't spawn on the desk in Graham Memorial when skipping the dialogue with the nurse
[*] Fixed a bug where ghouls didn't reach the player in a room in Graham Manor 2F
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3 - 02.02.2025
notes.notes:
Small update:

[list]
[*] Hotfix: Fixed a bug where sometimes the Adam room key wasn't dropped. This wasn't game breaking, but prevented players from [spoiler]getting a weapon upgrade[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug where in some very rare cases the tutorial message for equipping weapons could lead to a crash when using the keyboard
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2 - Build 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Hi all,

a new patch has been released.
This patch removes a few bugs and adjusts the balancing of the game. I adjusted the difficulty of the Path of Faith and Tower of Faith for the difficulties Moderate, Easy and Very Easy. Detailed More details below:

31.01.2025 - Build 1.1.6
[list]
[*] Fixed a few obsolete warp triggers that were still visible in Inspect mode
[*] Fixed two bugs where you could enter the dark part of the old tunnels without receiving a prompt that reminds you to carry the lantern
[*] Fixed a bug where killing [spoiler]Danielle[/spoiler] could cause a crash when re-entering the room
[*] Fixed a bug where skipping one of the final scenes mid-cutscene could lead to a game freeze
[*] Added that the [spoiler]hammer[/spoiler] will be removed permanently from the inventory after two uses
[*] Adjusted the [spoiler]Joseph 2nd Phase[/spoiler] enemy hitbox
[*] Slightly readjusted the statue puzzle in Graham Manor
[*] Fixed a bug where using first aid kits, antivenom, strong antipsychotics or bandages from the quick select menu could lead to removal of all items of the same id from the inventory
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the Tower of Faith on Moderate, Easy and Very Easy difficulty
[*] Fixed that the Adam room key could be picked up with Olivia within a few frames before the scene transition is triggered
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the Path of Faith on Moderate, Easy and Very Easy difficulty
[*] Corrected the death animation when killed by a swinging blade (default)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1 - 26.01.2025 - Build 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I have just released a patch that deals with some of the bugs that have already been reported and that I've been able to reproduce. One of them caused crashes, so be sure to keep your game updated.
There are a few other (seemingly rare) issues that I'm still working on. If you encounter any bugs or other weird behaviour, please report it in the forum, I've created an extra subforum for these issues. Thank you!


[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't inspect the dead body of a maid in Graham Manor (will only work in a new game)
[*] Fixed a bug where you could pass terrain in the final sequence of the game that shouldn't be passable
[*] Fixed a bug where the first boss rarely could get stuck in place due to a collision on a light source
[*] Fixed a bug where disabling tutorial messages could lead to a crash
[*] Fixed a bug where the text for difficulty options was cut off at the edge of the screen in some languages
[*] Fixed a bug where dying while picking up ammo could lead to a bugged clue pickup when reloading a save file
[*] Fixed a bug where you can repeatedly interact with a button in the gallery puzzle as the camera moves
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date announcement
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I'm happy to finally share that [i]Dead of Darkness[/i] will release on Steam on [b]January 23rd, 2025[/b]!

It's been almost 4 years since I drafted the first few ideas for the game late at night on Christmas Eve 2020. Back then, I never would have thought that the project would grow to the size and scope it has today—let alone reach an actual Steam release!

In case you missed it, here is the list of the voice cast for [i]Dead of Darkness[/i]:

Bradley Gareth ([i]"My Time at Portia", "Genshin Impact","Tiny Tina's Wonderlands"[/i])
Abigail Turner ([i]"Remothered: Broken Porcelain","My Time at Portia","Immortals of Aveum"[/i])
Paul Moran ([i]"Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader"[/i])
Alex Mai ([i]"Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty","Live A Live","One Piece"[/i])
Alice Himora ([i]"Re: Cutie Honey", "Honkai: Star Rail.","Ikai"[/i])
Ginger Sue ([i]"My Time at Sandrock","Devil May Cry: Peak of Combat","Genshin Impact"[/i])
Christ Sharpes ([i]"Return of the Obra Dinn","Grim Dawn: Forgotten Gods","Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader"[/i])
Katie Aitken ([i]"Ophelia's Chapter", "President Rocket"[/i])
Jericho George
Pixie Willow

Here is the release date trailer, with some new gameplay scenes:

[previewyoutube=mgkquIEORjM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you guys for your support! 
I wish you all a wonderful holiday season and hope to see you when [i]Dead of Darkness[/i] launches on [b]January 23rd[/b]!


Markus

notes.title: New trailer and new release window
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm thrilled to bring you some exciting news today.

Last year, I launched the store page with just a teaser trailer, and today, I'm delighted to share my first gameplay trailer with you!

This trailer is a sneak peek into the heart of the game. It dives into the core gameplay loop, showcasing combat, puzzles, and the intricacies of managing your inventory. Plus, it offers a glimpse into how crucial clues will be for solving some mind-bending puzzles. I've even included a selection of dialogue snippets to give you a taste of the storytelling that awaits. And, of course, the music you hear is straight from the finished game soundtrack!

You can watch it here or head to the store page to watch it.
[previewyoutube=Q21wPw3KtSo;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoy it, let me know in the comments!


Now, I've got another update to share. While I initially aimed for a 2023 release, I've made the decision to shift the launch to sometime in 2024. Some parts of the game have become bigger and more complex than I anticipated, and I don't want to cut anything or take any shortcuts. It's done when it's done and I'm happy with the way things are progressing.

I appreciate your unwavering interest and support for the game. It means the world to me.

Stay tuned for more updates, and until next time, thank you for being part of this incredible community!

Warm regards,

Markus
Retrofiction Games
